name: Zenventory
description: Stock, orders, and shipping for an online seller or a small warehouse that ships for others. Phoenix. Founded 2007.

mentions.evidence: GetLatka estimates about $880,000 a year as of September 2025, with 8 employees. The company has not published revenue. The homepage, seen 14 November 2026, lists Starter at $499 a month, currently $249 for the first 3 months, for up to 10,000 shipments and 1 warehouse, and Growth at $799 a month, currently $399, for up to 50,000 shipments and 3 warehouses. Those prices are the menu, not the estimate.
mentions.indieAngle: Price by shipment volume. A warehouse tool next to the local shop platform.

whyItPrints: The price steps up with how many shipments go out. A small team, and a high sticker for a small tool.
whyThisMatters: An online seller or a small warehouse that ships for other people needs stock, orders, and labels. Zenventory has sold that since 2007, out of Phoenix. GetLatka estimates about 880,000 dollars a year as of September 2025, with 8 employees. The company has not published revenue. The homepage, seen 14 November 2026, lists Starter at 499 dollars a month, currently 249 dollars for the first 3 months, for up to 10,000 shipments and 1 warehouse. Growth is 799 dollars a month, currently 399, for up to 50,000 shipments and 3 warehouses. The listed prices are a menu. They are not the yearly estimate. The figure is self-reported, which means a data site estimated it. I did not open the books. Phoenix, founded in 2007. Starter covers one warehouse. Growth covers three. The promo prices for the first three months are a discount on the menu, not a revenue total. Eight employees sit next to the September 2025 estimate. The company has not published its own revenue. Shipping for other people is the warehouse version of the same job.
